WGI.Settings.ApiKey.Name: Wanderer's Guide API key
WGI.Settings.ApiKey.Hint: Your WG API client key (36 characters). Stored only in this browser (client setting). Each character must grant this API client in Wanderer's Guide.
WGI.Settings.FunctionsUrl.Name: WG functions URL
WGI.Settings.FunctionsUrl.Hint: Base URL of the Wanderer's Guide edge functions. Local dev: http://127.0.0.1:8000/functions/v1
WGI.Settings.ClientId.Name: WG API client id
WGI.Settings.ClientId.Hint: Optional. The 8-character client id shown next to your API key in Wanderer's Guide. When set, the list only marks characters granted to this client.
